about_the_game:
Experience True Paranoia

Your clone is hiding among the crowd, ready to kill you when you’re at your most vulnerable. Search for weapons, be aware of your limited ammo, and carefully examine the hundreds of faces around you to identify your clone. Make sure to watch your back – danger lurks around every corner!

Threats, Enemies, and Biological Horrors

Progress through this roguelite experience, unlocking new tactics to survive each threat you encounter. As you advance through the story, new dangers, enemies, and challenges wait to test you.

What’s Behind These Mysterious Clones?

Explore a strange, dystopian reality to uncover the story behind the clones. Reveal the truth about these mysterious imposters as you fight for the very survival of humanity.

reviews:
“It blends Guess Who with Hitman, and its demo is one of the best I've played in ages. It's an ingenious concept.”
PC Gamer

“The demo has provoked in me some of the most pulse-quickening paranoia since the days of DayZ. I remain both intrigued and perturbed by the more overtly horror-flavoured antagonist variants that the final game will feature.”
Rock Paper Shotgun

“It’s a simple concept that’s cleverly implemented and gets incredibly nerve-wracking as you make your way through the crowds knowing that one of them is wearing your face. Highly recommended”
Alpha Beta Gamer
short_description: Kill your clone before it kills YOU! In this roguelite sandbox horror game, experience true paranoia as you hide, hunt, and try to eliminate your double. Fight to survive as you unravel this terrifying tale of clones and biological horrors!
supported_languages: English, Turkish, French, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese
